payload.reason: The evidence provides specific comparisons of training set sizes for ELMo models, indicating that newer models are trained on significantly larger datasets than previous versions.

claims.text: The original ELMo model was trained on a one billion word corpus, while newer models for specific languages were trained on datasets significantly larger than 20 million tokens used in earlier models.
For the Latvian language, the new ELMo model was trained on 270 million tokens compared to the 20 million tokens used by ELMoForManyLangs.
The evidence suggests that training on a few hundred million tokens is sufficient for effective ELMo model performance, indicating a substantial increase in training set size.
